method: parent actually opened primary publisher pages; short original summaries; no copied full definitions/IPA/examples

observations: Grammar category includes main, subordinate and coordinate/independent clauses; it need not constitute a sentence. A separate noun is a section of a legal document.
Noun: the action of bringing goods from abroad; separately, imported goods/products; separately, importance or meaning.
Verb: buy or bring goods from another country; computing: bring information/data from another software/device.
Uncountable noun: controlling/organizing an organization, resources or life. Separately, collective people who control/organize a business.
